label.purpose: Column headers, form labels, badges, legends.

motion.name: state-fade
motion.purpose: Hover feedback on buttons, navigation and key figures.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in a group.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: 600 14px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; height: 32px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #15181c; border-radius: 2px; background: #15181c; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #2d343b; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a6cff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-2 { font: 600 14px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; height: 32px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #15181c; border-radius: 2px; background: #fff; color: #15181c; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-2:hover { background: #eceef0; } .ds-btn-2:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a6cff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { font: 14px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #8a929c; border-radius: 2px; background: #fff; color: #15181c; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a6cff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Risk Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0 7px; line-height: 20px; font: 600 12.5px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; border-radius: 2px; background: #d4001f; color: #fff; }

components.name: Navigation Band
components.description: Graphite band of text links with a yellow active underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; background: #23282e; } .ds-nav a { color: #d7dce1; padding: 0 12px; height: 38px; display: flex; align-items: center; font: 13.5px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #fff; background: #2d343b; } .ds-nav a.on { color: #fff; font-weight: 650; border-bottom-color: #ffd400; }

components.name: Key Figure
components.description: A cell of the ruled key-figure strip.
components.css: .ds-kpi { padding: 12px 16px; border-top: 2px solid #15181c; background: #fff; font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-kpi .v { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #d4001f; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-kpi .l { font-size: 12.5px; color: #4b535c; }

narrative.overview: EOS reads like a station timetable. Everything hangs on a strict grid of ink-black rules and hairlines over a pale, cool ground, set in a humanist sans with tabular numerals. Colour is information: ordinary state is plain ink, and only deviation earns red or yellow.
keyCharacteristics: Ink on cool pale ground; one signal red and one timetable yellow, nothing else saturated.
Tabular numerals throughout; numbers right-aligned in their columns.
Sections ruled, not boxed; no shadows, no nested containers.
Black station band for identity and the as-of date plate; graphite band for navigation.

rules.name: The Deviation-Only Rule
rules.body: Colour appears only where something deviates from plan.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numerals are always tabular and numeric columns right-aligned.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No box shadows, blurs or gradients anywhere.

dos: Do keep ordinary state plain ink and let red (#d4001f) and yellow (#ffd400) mark deviation only.
Do align every numeric column right with tabular figures.
Do separate sections with a 2px ink rule and rows with a 1px hairline.
Do keep controls rectangular with a 2px corner and a visible 2px focus ring.
donts: Don't use cards, nested containers, shadows, gradients or glass.
Don't use coloured side-stripes on rows or callouts, icon glyphs as decoration, or a second typeface.
Don't colour healthy states green; healthy is ink.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading.
